profile.en: Information Technology fresh graduate (GPA 3.77/4.00) focused on data cleaning, data analysis, and machine learning. Experienced in building an end-to-end sentiment analysis pipeline on 63,766 user reviews with 94.38% model accuracy. Skilled in Python, SQL, and Microsoft Excel to turn raw data into actionable insights, and accustomed to presenting analytical findings through interactive Streamlit dashboards. Meticulous, analytical, and ready to contribute as a Data Analyst.
